data.name: Pranil
data.gender_notes: Pranil is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Pranil is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Prana' meaning life force or breath. The name signifies the lord of Prana or the one who embodies the essence of life. The name Pranil carries the meaning “Lord of Prana” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Pranil usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of prana and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Pranil is a name that resonates with the divine energy of life. It is believed to bring vitality, energy, and a sense of connection to the cosmos. It is a name that is deeply rooted in spirituality and is often given to children who are expected to grow up to be spiritual leaders or guides.
data.etymology: Pranil belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Prana.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pranil total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
